question: The Hindu college was established in 1791 at _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Banaras**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Hindu college **was established in **1791 **to encourage the study of ancient Sanskrit texts.
 
• Sri **Jonathan Duncan** and Governor General Lord **Cornwallis** established the Sanskrit college.
 
• **Jonathan Duncan **suggested establishing a Sanskrit college to develop and preserve Sanskrit Vangmaya to demonstrate **British support for Indian education**.
 
• The Governor of Uttar Pradesh is the chancellor of the College.
 
 
• **Chancellor **- Anandiben Patel
 
• **Vice Chairman** - Hare Ram Tripathi
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

__
 
• Hindu college, now called Presidency University, is a public state university in **Calcutta**.
 
• It was established in the year **1817.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In **1958 **The Sanskrit college became a university and in **1974 **the name was changed to Sampumanand Sanskrit University.
 
• It became a university on 22 March 1958 by the then Chief Minister Dr Sampurnanand and Education Minister Pt. Kamlapati Tripathi at Varanasi.
 
• **A.N. Jha** was the **First Vice-Chancellor**. It Was Renamed Sampurnanand Sanskrit University under the U.P. State University Act, of 1973.
 
• Introduction of Civil service by **Lord Cornwallis**.
 
• Permanent Settlement 1793 by **Lord Cornwallis**.
 
• **Kumar Gupta I** of the Gupta dynasty founded Nalanda University in the 5th century CE.
 
• **Dharmapala** founded Vikramshila University.
